version.value: Original work for brass and percussion, composed in 1942
version.note: The sleeve identifies the standalone Fanfare, not an extract from Symphony No. 3. The edition and performing parts used are unknown.

performers.note: Both are credited on the Vanguard sleeve. Individual players are not identified.

date.note: 1961 is the carrier publication year in the Archive catalogue, not a documented session year. Neither the consulted sleeve nor the item metadata establishes the session date.

place.note: The ensemble’s name does not establish the recording venue.

label.note: Stereo vinyl LP; the sleeve describes Vanguard’s stereophonic recording and disc-cutting system.

catalogue.note: The specific transferred US carrier is catalogued as a 1961 release.

matrixTakeSides.note: Side and band follow the segmented filename and programme order. Matrix, take and stamper identifiers are unknown.

composition.value: Copyrighted Copland composition; permissions administered by Boosey & Hawkes for the Aaron Copland Fund for Music
composition.note: The Fund expressly states that Fanfare is not in the public domain. A phonogram term assessment does not clear the composition, an arrangement, or a modern score edition.

recording.value: Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: commercial publication in 1961, before 1963
recording.note: The project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule applies to the documented Vanguard carrier: its former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is not US or worldwide clearance, not a Creative Commons licence, and not a US-government recording. Composition rights remain separate.
